fieldValues.title: Is work grounded?
fieldValues.measurement_method: Share of merged PRs whose issue answers an affirmed problem, and separately with an affirmed persona-in-domain and domain. Computed by `clerk ground --since <date> [--until <date>]`; recorded per cycle by `clerk measure --group <wg:label> --write` as a measurement-result.
fieldValues.baseline_state: Retroactive for the cycle before the two-domain walk (about 0%); compared with the next two cycles (clerk#25).
